name: What is the typical cost range for ADU construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for ADU construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of ADU construction varies widely based on factors such as size, type (attached, detached, conversion), materials chosen, site conditions, and interior finishes. A garage conversion might start around $80,000 to $120,000, while a new detached ADU can range from $150,000 to $350,000 or more. These figures generally include design, permits, and construction, but specific project costs require a detailed estimate after a site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU construction costs vary significantly, from approximately $80,000 for a garage conversion to over $350,000 for a new detached unit, depending on size and finishes.
